_comment: Shared sensor & entity definitions for ALL EHG vehicles (v2.43.0+).
_doc: Only entries guaranteed on every SCU belong here (buses 1, 3, 30, 45).
Brand/model-specific buses go in hymer.json, eriba.json, etc.
Keys: bus_id,sensor_id. Values: objects with decode + entity metadata.
No platform = decode-only (value stored but no HA entity created).
Array format [name, unit, transform] still supported for backward compat.
_naming: ENTITY NAMING CONVENTION (v2.70.1+). 'name' is the stable object_id suffix HA uses to
build the entity_id. It is FROZEN once shipped - NEVER rename an existing entity, that
breaks user dashboards & automations. A correction is done by adding a NEW alias, never
<group>     = what the user thinks in: a function domain (fridge, heater, water, solar,
battery/bms, tank, sat, tpms, awning, light, habitation) OR a brand/product
when the brand IS the identity (dometic, truma, alde, victron, cerbo).
<qualifier> = short disambiguator, ONLY when two devices share a group on overlapping
vehicles (fridge_absorber vs fridge_compressor; heater vs truma vs alde).
<function>  = the measured/controlled quantity (voltage, current, soc, door, power, mode,
Never encode the EHG componentId or the bus number in the name (e.g. 'dometicseries10_*'
or 'bus9_*' are internal-only, not user-facing). Every appliance entity carries
require_observed so it materialises only when the vehicle actually reports its bus.

Universal optional component - observation-gated so it only materialises on vehicles that actually report bus 9. sensors._aventa_doc: Truma Aventa Comfort air conditioner (EHG bus 7 = TrumaAventaComfort). Universal optional component - observation-gated so it only materialises on vehicles that actually report bus 7. READ-ONLY: the SCU mirrors the Aventa's state but silently drops writes to bus 7 (confirmed on a HYMER B-ML I 780, PR #18 / @stbcgn, 2026-07-30). Control the unit via its power output instead - on a HYMER Alde vehicle that is the Alde ACC output (switch alde_acc_ctrl, bus 5 slot 11) and the target temperature follows number.alde_setpoint (bus 5 slot 3). Distinct from the Truma Aventa Compact on bus 59 (Eriba).

7,1._doc: Truma Aventa setpoint / target temperature (bus 7 slot 1, float degC). Read-only mirror - float writes are dropped by the SCU. On an Alde-ACC vehicle the Aventa adopts the setpoint entered at the Alde panel; change it from HA via number.alde_setpoint (bus 5 slot 3). Confirmed on a HYMER B-ML I 780 (PR #18 / @stbcgn, 2026-07-30).
7,1.name: aventa_setpoint

7,3._doc: Truma Aventa operating mode (bus 7 slot 3, string): 'Off' / 'Cool' / 'Heat' / 'Fan' / 'Auto'. Read-only - string writes are dropped by the SCU; every switch of the power output (Alde ACC) flips this slot in the same second. Confirmed on a HYMER B-ML I 780 (PR #18 / @stbcgn, 2026-07-30).
7,3.name: aventa_mode

7,4._doc: Truma Aventa fan speed (bus 7 slot 4, string): 'Low' / 'Mid' / 'High' / 'Night' (Night = sleep mode). Read-only - writes are dropped by the SCU (it only mirrors the Aventa). While a timer is being programmed the SCU emits a raw 'Unknown mode: 0x..' string on this slot (produced by the SCU/cloud, not this integration). Confirmed on a HYMER B-ML I 780 (PR #18 / @stbcgn, 2026-07-30).

sensors._tpms_doc: TPMS (EHG bus 100, component 'TPMS', kind tpms). Universal optional component - observation-gated so it only materialises on vehicles that actually report bus 100. Pressures are int with a declared range 0-9500 'psi'; that range implies a scaled raw unit (e.g. psi*100), so pressures are shipped enabled:false with SCALE UNVERIFIED until a TPMS-equipped vehicle confirms the transform. Temperatures are EHG floats (direct degC per the Alde/Truma convention; -273 = no-data sentinel). Status/firmware are strings (safe decode).
sensors._cerbo_doc: Victron Cerbo GX energy monitor (EHG bus 97, component 'CerboGX', kind power_system). Semantics from the decompiled EHG app (componentId 97): LPG levels + battery V/A/SoC are direct floats/ints (safe). Two fields are shipped enabled:false with SCALE UNVERIFIED until a Cerbo-equipped vehicle confirms: slot 6 time_remaining (EHG unit is a bogus '%', raw max 99999999 => likely seconds/minutes) and slot 7 solar_panel_power (raw max 33542 'W' is implausibly high for a camper array => likely a scaled raw int).
